LottoResult.title: LottoResult
LottoResult.description: Represents an individual lottery drawing result, parsed from an image or input manually.

id.description: Unique identifier for the lottery drawing result

gameName.description: Name of the lottery game (e.g., MAD MAX, MANO)

extraNumbers.description: List of extra/bonus numbers, if any

machineNumbers.description: List of machine numbers, if any

sourceImageIndex.description: Index of the source image in preloaded results

/lotto_results/{id}.description: Collection of all lottery draw results, both preloaded and user-added/extracted
